stance_rationale: PD18 improves the surface time-series shape by extending alpha_scores to 184 dates, but the Forge package is not decision-grade: the mandated weights.csv path is missing, the actual schedules are stale 155-date static sleeve schedules, costs and turnover are zero in the realized backtest, and lockbox-period monthly rebalancing is treated as primary evidence despite unresolved PIT-C13/C14 carry. RF-F2, RF-F5, RF-F6, and RF-F7 remain unresolved, so AX-008 cannot count this as a clean Forge PASS.

critical_concerns.description: The mandated qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv is absent, while stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/weights.csv and judge_ready/weights.csv are 155-date high_20pct schedules ending 2023-11, not the claimed 184-date med_10pct PD18 schedule. run_all_pd18.R hardcodes sleeve weights instead of consuming a verified weights schedule, so the package's weights_csv_unique_dates_count=184 claim is not supported.

The primary PD18 evidence uses 2023-12 through 2026-04 monthly alpha refreshes as an OOS/extension performance driver, with no frozen buy-and-hold lockbox extension. The chart line is visible, but the OOS zoom is explicitly an alpha 29-new-dates monthly-rebal period, which conflicts with the base Lockbox promise unless formally segregated as non-lockbox operational monitoring.

Transaction costs and turnover are not realized in the Forge backtest: period_returns.csv has turnover=0 and cost_ret=0 for all 255 months, nav.csv has cum_cost=0, and build_bt_result_pd18.R asserts 15bps is already embedded even though build_pd18_new_sleeve_returns.R computes raw close-to-close top20 returns. This violates the mandatory 15bps cost and makes the SR/CAGR evidence overstated.

Forge does not provide integrated DSR or 5-spec Harvey regressions for the PD18 5-sleeve composite and same-period baseline. Risk-package 5-spec evidence is alpha-sleeve-level, not composite-level, and the package only says Judge re-spawn should later apply same-DSR-penalty M=18.

The PD18 alpha_scores extension still uses the dir_* expanding sign multiplier on Z_Score_Aligned and lacks a Usable_Date audit trail, while alpha challenge notes already accepted PIT-C13/C14 remediation as timeline work. Downstream Forge cannot mark PIT C1-C15 as inherited clean until that rebuild exists.

Hard constraints are audited at sleeve-placeholder level, not ticker level. The bt_result holdings file has 4 or 5 sleeve rows, not expanded NEW/STR_1715/ETF holdings, so per-date liquidity, max_names, per-security cap, actual turnover, and cost compliance are not directly verified.

Artifact lineage is inconsistent: the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_001 directory does not exist, the available covariance.parquet is 100x100 while risk_package describes a 249-security covariance, and existing certificates are stale PD16/155-date artifacts rather than PD18/184-date certificates.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function md5s match the package claims: alpha e0e1a525c84f33f228f00c061ac5d64d, risk 25a440e08232fcfb953ca912bffaa13a, optimization a810ddbaf40f5a90b054c521e915e106.
stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/alpha_scores.parquet is a real time-series artifact: 62,916 rows, 184 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2026-04-01, and 770 tickers.
The available covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.01217143 and condition number 8.812171, satisfying cond <= 100 for that 100x100 artifact.
Same-period S4 baseline returns are recomputed over 2005-02 to 2026-04, and equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png are present.
The PD18 period_returns.csv covers the full stated 255 months, but it is cost-free and schedule-free, so this supports diagnostics rather than approval.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a hardcoded static sleeve vector can satisfy the Forge walk-forward schedule requirement when the claimed 184-date med_10pct weights.csv is absent.
Whether lockbox-period monthly alpha refresh can be used as primary admit evidence without downgrading it from sealed OOS evidence to operational monitoring evidence.
Whether a zero-cost, zero-turnover bt_result can be reconciled with the 15bps one-way cost mandate and annual turnover hard constraint.
Whether PD18 can count as AX-008 Forge PASS before composite-level DSR M=18 and CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 regressions are produced.
Whether downstream Forge may inherit alpha PIT compliance while PIT-C13/C14 are explicitly timeline-accepted rather than remediated.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that PD18's 184-date monthly-rebalanced alpha extension can supersede the frozen lockbox basis and serve as clean primary Forge evidence while the med_10pct schedule, costs, turnover, DSR, composite 5-spec regressions, and PIT-C13/C14 remediation are still missing or inherited.
rebuttal_required: Publish the mandated 184-date med_10pct weights.csv at the specified mailbox path or formally amend the artifact contract, then make run_all_pd18.R consume that schedule.
Rebuild period_returns/nav/holdings with actual turnover and 15bps one-way transaction costs, including round-trip x2 where applicable.
Produce ticker-level holdings for every rebalance date, proving liquidity, per-name caps, max_names logic under AX-007 Exception 1, and sum_w=1.
Run PD18 composite-level DSR with M=18 or a defensible candidate count and apply the same penalty to candidate and baseline.
Run CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions on the PD18 5-sleeve composite, not only on the alpha sleeve.
Either rebuild alpha_scores under Z_Score_Aligned-only plus Usable_Date audit or mark all downstream PD18 evidence conditional on PIT-C13/C14 remediation.
Separate sealed lockbox/frozen extension evidence from operational monthly-refresh evidence and relabel oos_zoom_chart accordingly.
rationalization_red_flags: NOT lockbox OOS in strict sense

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: PD18 is useful as a diagnostic operational-refresh experiment, but it is not a clean Forge validation source until the schedule, cost/turnover, lockbox labeling, PIT remediation, and composite statistical tests are contract-clean.

forge_specific_questions: Pure Function v6.1 R12 hash audit이 PRE=POST 모두 일치하는가? Yes, the three package hashes match.
walk-forward 시계열 충분 (≥60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? No. alpha_scores has 184 sig_dates, but the mandated weights.csv is missing and available schedules are static 155-date artifacts.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? Yes, the strategy line is visible after the lockbox/extension markers, but frozen_extension_applied is false.
baseline 비교가 same-period · same-cost · same-DSR-penalty인가? Same-period is present; same-cost and same-DSR-penalty are not demonstrated.
